title: Languages at home
text: About half of McKinley County residents speak a language other than English at home, as of 2024, and Spanish accounts for only about 3,000 of them. One of the languages heard here is Zuni, a language isolate with no known relatives. It is spoken mostly around Zuni Pueblo.

s2.title: Zuni language
s2.quote: It is spoken by around 9,500 people, especially in the vicinity of Zuni Pueblo, New Mexico ... Zuni is considered a language isolate. ... Shiwiʼma ... pronounced [ˈʃiwiʔma]
